tools.name: zip_lookup
tools.description: City, state, county and FIPS, coordinates, time zone with UTC offset, and Census demographics (population, income, home value, rent) for up to 10 US ZIP codes. Accepts ZIP+4, addresses and ZIPs missing a leading zero.

tools.name: zips_in_radius
tools.description: Every US ZIP within N miles (max 25) of a ZIP or a lat/lon point, closest first, with distance in miles.

tools.name: city_zips
tools.description: All ZIP codes of a US city, largest population first.

tools.name: nearest_zip
tools.description: Reverse geocode a latitude/longitude to the nearest US ZIP code(s), with distance.

tools.name: zip_distance
tools.description: Great-circle distance in miles and km between two US ZIP codes.
